title: Gran Colombia–Peru War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Gran Colombia–Peru War", at revision 1381497131, opens: "The Gran Colombian–Peruvian War of 1828 and 1829 was the first international conflict fought by the Republic of Peru, which had gained its independence from Spain in 1821, and Gran Colombia, that existed between 1819 and 1830." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1972316, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1828-1829 war between Colombia and Peru". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
